_comment: The hand authored skill tree of every category. Loaded as window.Skills.SkillTrees by DataService and read by SkillGraph in js/plugins/CharacterCreation/SkillMaster.js. A branch is one subtree of a school: its nodes are ordered weakest to strongest, esoteric skills sit in the middle of that climb and forbidden ones close it, and a node requires the node one rung above it. Written by tools/skills/gen_skill_trees.js: edit the tables there, not this file.
